goal: Reduce durable mailbox inbox polling work without losing/reordering messages or changing contracts
scope: Local SQLite synthetic envelope workload, no LLM/token/e2e quality claim
hypothesis: A recipient/sequence partial index over receipt IS NULL avoids scanning acknowledged deliveries; measure existing query before deciding whether an ordered query adjustment is needed.
invariants: same exact inbox result and FIFO order
all references and budget checks unchanged
workloads: multiple interleaved runs with pending messages in other runs

measurement.acceptance: Exact behavior all cases; >80% VM-step decrease and >=2x median on acknowledged-backlog cases; report all controls and write overhead. No timing gate in unit tests.
